title: Consume European White Flowers signed byte projection
changes: Publish and serve a 48-byte signed projection while retaining the existing root owner and original fallback for outside cursors.
validation: Wine reader passes 14 original interpreter/generated cases including original helper and outside indices 48 and 255; mirrors, mixed boundaries, source authentication and snapshots pass.
Wine scene compares 700 altered-source White Flowers frames; production CLI creates, reuses and verifies 148 files; static join accounts for three sampled bytes. All Wine servers drained.
limitations: The E362 sample leaves 3,603 unowned bytes including 3,600 copied-code support; true asset extent, producer ancestry, other scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements were made.
